title: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
slides: Can texting DoorDash replace scrolling menus?
Its AI agent takes orders via SMS
Expect it messy on custom combos
Test it on your weirdest order tonight
thread_text:
1. Forget menus, just text

DoorDash's new AI agent takes your order via SMS. No app, no scrolling. It's a full conversation with a bot that remembers your usual.

2. AI that chats back

You text what you want. The agent asks follow-up questions, suggests add-ons, and confirms. It's like ordering from a friend who knows the menu.

3. When AI gets picky

Special requests like 'no onions' work fine. But ask for extra sauce on the side? The agent second-guesses and may mess up.

4. Custom combos = chaos

Try ordering a burger with no bun, extra pickles, and a side of ranch. The AI gets confused. Expect errors on anything non-standard.

5. Test your weirdest order

Tonight, text DoorDash your craziest combo. See if the AI nails it or flakes. Share the result—would you trust it again?

instagram.caption:
You can now order dinner by sending a text instead of opening an app.

DoorDash launched an AI agent that takes your order over SMS and remembers your usual. 😮

It handles simple tweaks like “no onions” fine, but second-guesses anything custom.

Ask for a burger with no bun and a side of ranch, and it gets confused. 😅

If you post food content, save your weirdest combo as a test case, because your audience will ask how the bot handles it. 🍔

What’s the strangest order you’d text it tonight? 🤖
